summary_en: Introduces a far-field super-resolution ultrasound imaging method based on composite acoustic orbital angular momentum. By synthesizing vortex beams over multiple topological charges, the method extends the accessible angular spectrum and recovers subdiffraction spatial detail. Simulations and underwater experiments report 0.2-lambda and 0.24-lambda resolution, respectively, with demonstrations on wires, steel structures, blood-vessel targets, and chirality discrimination.

summary_en: Develops a single-input multiple-output 3D acoustic-vortex imaging method using stepped-frequency cyclic excitation of a circular array. Synchronous reception synthesizes equivalent integer and fractional OAM modes without multi-channel phase control; pulse compression provides range while Fourier-domain processing recovers azimuth and elevation. Numerical and experimental results demonstrate millimeter-scale range resolution and sub-degree angular precision.

summary_en: Proposes a solid-immersion modification of an acoustic Luneburg lens using a variable-thickness thin-plate refractive-index profile. Numerical and experimental results show broadband enhanced-resolution focusing of flexural waves, with a reported FWHM around 0.3 lambda over 8-20 kHz, providing a compact route to subwavelength acoustic imaging and focusing.
